test_title: PYST 41: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the given series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 3 6 5 4 1 2 5 8 9 7 4 5 6 (Right)

How many such odd digits are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an odd digit?
solution:
**Given:** (Left) 3 6 5 4 1 2 5 8 9 7 4 5 6 (Right)

Now,

Odd digits, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an odd digit.

So, the needed pattern is: Even — Odd — Odd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/664a071abe426df7c7a66166cacc1d4001972ffeb57cf2b077607e0be3b92868.png] Thus, there is one odd digit, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an odd digit.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
